exposure: planned vs. actual mode of delivery
outcome: composite outcome of NNM, CP, and death during birth
cohort: 520,047 term-born singletons without congenital malformations born in Norway between 1999 and 2009
finding: While vaginal breech delivery was associated with a higher risk of NNM compared to vaginal cephalic delivery, it was not associated with an increased risk of CP.
mod_finding: Both planned and actual vaginal breech delivery were associated with increased risk for NNM compared to planned cephalic delivery, but not with CP; actual breech cesarean delivery also had increased NNM risk compared to planned cephalic delivery.
